prompts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: LingNote settings navigation transparent PNG. Generate one isolated icon: a compact microphone with a short upright rounded capsule, a broad U-shaped cradle, a short stem and a horizontal foot. The complete natural silhouette is 14 units wide by 16 units tall; do not make the capsule squat or flattened. Modern flat minimalist outline icon. Uniform charcoal #22262C stroke, rounded caps and joins, 1.8-unit stroke in conceptual 24x24 square canvas. Icon centered in a 16x16 optical area, consistent 4-unit transparent margins. Do not stretch the design to fill the square canvas.
